item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":4,"rationale":"The President presently exempts qualifying heavy crude oil sales from price controls (Code 3), while also directing the Secretary to conduct a later public inquiry (Code 1); these materially different postures are combined in one supplied segment.","evidence":"prices charged in the first sale of heavy crude oil are exempted from price controls"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretary must provide an advisory recommendation and may issue implementation regulations at his discretion; the segment does not dictate a later regulatory outcome.","evidence":"The Secretary of Energy may pursuant to Executive Order 11790, as amended by Executive Order 12038, adopt such regulations as he deems necessary to implement this Order."}]}
